origin_diagnosis: Family G showed that a single return inside the original breakout level removes losses but also cuts recovery winners. Descriptive cross-year diagnosis found that trades remaining inside at two checkpoints without intervening reacceptance had negative baseline outcomes in 2023, 2024 H1 and 2024 H2.
causal_hypothesis: Persistent structural invalidation without reacceptance identifies permanent F05 failure more reliably than a single structural checkpoint.

novelty.not_family_G: two structural states plus the intervening reacceptance path, rather than a single checkpoint or nearby buffer
novelty.not_family_D: distance is measured against the original breakout level and requires structural non-reacceptance, not absolute entry P/L adversity
novelty.not_family_E: trigger does not use exposure support or defer exits based on portfolio state

trigger_contract.path_condition: maximum executable structural outside pips between first and second checkpoints <= reacceptance_threshold_pips
trigger_contract.exit_price: actual second-checkpoint M15 bar-open executable Bid for long and Ask for short

development_periods.2024_H2: development and cross-regime analysis under period policy v4

required_metrics: affected positions and entry dates by period/month
ranking: minimum candidate net across the three periods
falsification: no cell passes every period and pooled gate
benefit depends on two dates or one month
winner harm is not below loss avoided
prohibited: No additional checkpoints, buffers, scopes or shadow-health filters after results
No 2025 outcome use for mechanism, threshold or ranking
No repair or reopening of Families D through G
No MT4 or 2025 access unless one exact finalist passes and is separately frozen
